source.interpretation: An extendable mission can remain suspended across a result-window end while simulation continues to eventual completion.

exact_delta: Control.RCEND changes from 16.0 to 12.5 hours while Control.SIMPE stays 16.0 hours.
Both ResultCollection.RCEND rows change from 16.0 to 12.5 hours.
ProblemDescription.PDESC changes descriptive label only; all aircraft, mission, preparation, failure/repair, seed and schedule fields stay fixed.
predeclared_native_acceptance: One immutable guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID 13340 identity guard, source and raw SHA-256 seals, four CLI steps and exact row-containing source roundtrip.
Conversion must have zero errors; classify warnings. Compare the complete simulation event log to the accepted A06 parent without assuming identical stochastic events merely from the fixed seed.

If the second suspension spans the 12.5 report end and the simulation continues to completion, require an event-log resumption and completion after 12.5 while the result bins stop at 12.5. Compare the 0–12.5 result integrals with the accepted A06.var04 simulation-stop control, distinguishing any summary result differences.
Do not infer post-12.5 operation from truncated result bins. Reconcile the report-window totals and separately state any full-run conclusion supported by the later event log.
If the report end changes simulation behavior or its output fails to expose the intended distinction, retain the run as a probe and publish only directly supported behavior.
limits: One fixed seed and observed stochastic failure times; the report end was chosen from an accepted event timeline, not a deterministic unavailable interval.
Report-window totals and full-simulation outcomes have different time scopes and must not be conflated.
Other result windows, GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
